Step 3: Ultra-relativistic photon kinematics (E = pc) in 3 dimensions gives isotropic radiation pressure P = (1/3) u = (1/3) a T^4. Step 5: Combining dV coefficients: 4 a V T^3 dT + (4/3) a T^4 dV = 0. Step 6: Separate variables by dividing by (4/3) a V T^4: (4 a V T^3 dT) / ((4/3) a V T^4) + ((4/3) a T^4 dV) / ((4/3) a V T^4) = 0 => 3 (dT / T) + (dV / V) = 0 => dT / T + (1/3) dV / V = 0. Step 7: Integrating both sides: 3 ln(T) + ln(V) = const => ln(T^3 V) = const => T^3 V = const, or T V^(1/3) = const. Equivalent polytropic form: with P proportional to T^4, T proportional to P^(1/4), so (P^(1/4))^3 V = const => P^(3/4) V = const => P V^(4/3) = const (effective gamma = 4/3). Step 8: For a 3D spherical cavity of radius R, V = (4/3) pi R^3 proportional to R^3. Substituting: T ((4/3) pi R^3)^(1/3) = const => T R = const. Limiting cases: as R -> infinity, T -> 0, precisely describing cosmic microwave background expansion redshift. All 8 steps verified.
